items.name: Weekend dip
items.desc: Buys a stock token when it trades below Friday's close while the market is shut.
items.prompt: Buy $200 of NVDA stock token when the US market is closed and NVDA is 3% below its daily average; stop loss 5%.

items.name: Funding flip
items.desc: Opens a perp when funding changes sign and holds for an hour.
items.prompt: Long $200 of SOL perp when SOL funding turns negative and stays negative for 60 minutes; stop loss 4%.

items.name: Odds breakout
items.desc: Uses a Polymarket probability crossing a level as a trigger for any venue.
items.prompt: When Fed-cut-in-December odds cross above 70%, buy $300 of SPY stock token; take profit 3%.

items.name: Take-profit ladder
items.desc: Sells in three steps at +10%, +20% and +35%, then trails the rest.
items.prompt: Add a take-profit ladder: sell a third at +10%, a third at +20%, a third at +35%.

items.name: Scale in
items.desc: Splits an entry into equal buys spaced by time or by price.
items.prompt: Buy $100 of ETH perp every day at 14:00 UTC.
